verdict.rationale: The QuickBooks Workforce API documentation lists OAuth as part of its developer offering. That gives a first-party mechanism for issuing delegated API credentials an agent could use. However, the evidence never mentions scopes, permission granularity, or least-privilege restrictions, so the 'scoped' part of the story is only implied. Missing for 10: documented OAuth scopes or permission levels for payroll data, read-only or limited-access credential options, agent-specific token management, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
